trans-unit.source: These services gather anonymous data for statistical analysis and performance optimization. Enabling analytics services assists website owners in making informed decisions to enhance online services.
trans-unit.target: Ka kohi ēnei ratonga i ngā raraunga ingoamuna mō te tātari tauanga me te whakapai ake i te mahinga. Mā te whakahohe i ngā ratonga tātaritanga ka āwhina i ngā rangatira paetukutuku ki te whakatau mōhio hei whakapai ake i ngā ratonga tuihono.

trans-unit.source: Security services are crucial for safeguarding your online experience. These services help protect your data and privacy by detecting and preventing security threats, such as malware, phishing attempts, and unauthorized access. They ensure a safer browsing environment.
trans-unit.target: He tino nui ngā ratonga haumarutanga hei tiaki i tō wheako tuihono. Ka āwhina ēnei ratonga ki te tiaki i ō raraunga me tō tūmataiti mā te kimi me te ārai i ngā mōrearea haumarutanga pērā i te malware, ngā nganatanga phishing, me te urunga kāore i whakaaetia. Ka whakarite i tētahi taiao tirotiro haumaru ake.

trans-unit.source: Live chat services enable real-time communication with website support teams. They offer a convenient way to ask questions, seek assistance, or engage in discussions while browsing a website. Live chat enhances your online interaction and customer support experience.
trans-unit.target: Ka āhei ngā ratonga kōrerorero ora ki te whakawhitiwhiti kōrero ā-tūturu me ngā tīma tautoko o te paetukutuku. He huarahi ngāwari ēnei ki te pātai, ki te rapu āwhina, ki te whai wāhi rānei ki ngā kōrerorero i a koe e tirotiro ana i tētahi paetukutuku. Ka whakapai ake te kōrerorero ora i tō taunekeneke tuihono me tō wheako tautoko kiritaki.

trans-unit.source: Services related to styling help to improve the appearance of the website. This can also have an impact on usability.
trans-unit.target: Ka āwhina ngā ratonga e pā ana ki te whakatahua ki te whakapai ake i te āhua o te paetukutuku. Ka pā hoki pea tēnei ki te whakamahinga.

trans-unit.source: Embedding videos from external platforms to enrich the content on this website.

trans-unit.source: Adobe Fonts provides web fonts used for this website. When enabled, font files are loaded from Adobe and technical connection data may be processed.
trans-unit.target: Ka whakarato a Adobe Fonts i ngā momotuhi tukutuku e whakamahia ana mō tēnei paetukutuku. Ina whakahohea, ka utaina ngā kōnae momotuhi mai i Adobe, ā, tērā pea ka tukatukahia ngā raraunga hononga hangarau.

trans-unit.source: Google AdSense enables personalized ads on websites while respecting user privacy. By consenting, you allow relevant ads and help support free content.
trans-unit.target: Ka āhei a Google AdSense ki ngā pānuitanga kua whakaritea ki runga paetukutuku me te whakaute tonu i te tūmataiti o te kaiwhakamahi. Mā tō whakaae ka whakaaetia ngā pānuitanga hāngai, ā, ka āwhina koe ki te tautoko i ngā ihirangi koreutu.

trans-unit.source: Consent to the use of surveillance camera images for security and safety purposes, in compliance with applicable data privacy regulations.
trans-unit.target: Whakaaetanga ki te whakamahi i ngā whakaahua kāmera tirotiro mō ngā kaupapa haumarutanga me te haumaru, i raro i ngā ture tūmataiti raraunga e hāngai ana.

trans-unit.source: Career Captain provides gamified career orientation and recruiting content. When enabled, external content from Career Captain may process usage and technical connection data.
trans-unit.target: Ka whakarato a Career Captain i ngā ihirangi arataki umanga me te kimi kaimahi kua whakakēmetia. Ina whakahohea, tērā pea ka tukatukahia e ngā ihirangi o waho mai i Career Captain ngā raraunga whakamahinga me ngā raraunga hononga hangarau.

trans-unit.source: Microsoft Clarity is a user-friendly web analytics tool that empowers website visitors like you by providing transparency about how your interactions are tracked on a website. It ensures your privacy is respected while giving developers and website owners valuable insights into user behavior. Plus, it follows coding guidelines and best practices, ensuring a safe and secure online experience for you.
trans-unit.target: He taputapu web analytics māmā ki te kaiwhakamahi a Microsoft Clarity e tuku ana i te māramatanga mō te āhua o te aroturuki i āu taunekeneke ki tētahi paetukutuku. Ka whakarite kia whakautea tō tūmataiti, ā, ka tuku tirohanga whaihua ki ngā kaiwhakawhanake me ngā rangatira paetukutuku mō te whanonga kaiwhakamahi. Ka whai hoki i ngā coding guidelines me ngā best practices hei whakarite i tētahi wheako tuihono haumaru māu.

trans-unit.source: Cloudflare helps protect and optimize websites. By using this website, you consent to Cloudflare's data processing practices as described in its Privacy Policy.
trans-unit.target: Ka āwhina a Cloudflare ki te tiaki me te whakapai ake i ngā paetukutuku. Mā te whakamahi i tēnei paetukutuku ka whakaae koe ki ngā mahi tukatuka raraunga a Cloudflare e whakaahuatia ana i tana Privacy Policy.

trans-unit.source: Simplifies web tracking for analytics and marketing while ensuring data compliance and control.
trans-unit.target: Ka whakamāmā i te aroturuki tukutuku mō te tātaritanga me te tauhokohoko, me te whakarite kia ū ki ngā ture raraunga me te mana whakahaere.

trans-unit.source: Fast Fonts, operated by fonts.com and supplied by fast.fonts.net, is a service for the provision of web fonts. It requires the use of a pixel-code for continuous price calculation.
trans-unit.target: Ko Fast Fonts, e whakahaerehia ana e fonts.com, ā, e tukuna ana e fast.fonts.net, he ratonga mō te whakarato momotuhi tukutuku. Me whakamahi he pixel-code mō te tātai utu haere tonu.

trans-unit.source: Google Ads allows advertisers to reach their target audience online. To personalize ads and measure their effectiveness, Google may collect data with your consent.
trans-unit.target: Ka āhei a Google Ads i ngā kaiwhakapānui ki te toro ki tō rātou hunga whāinga tuihono. Hei whakarite pānuitanga me te ine i tōna whaihua, tērā pea ka kohi raraunga a Google mā tō whakaaetanga.

Ngā momotuhi tukutuku e manaakihia ana e Google

trans-unit.source: Google Maps allows for the integration of interactive maps on websites, enabling location-based services. Developers can utilize it while ensuring data compliance and control, adhering to coding guidelines and best practices.
trans-unit.target: Ka āhei a Google Maps ki te whakauru mahere pāhekoheko ki runga paetukutuku, e tautoko ana i ngā ratonga ā-wāhi. Ka taea e ngā kaiwhakawhanake te whakamahi i a ia me te whakarite kia ū ki ngā ture raraunga me te mana whakahaere, ā, kia whai i ngā coding guidelines me ngā best practices.

trans-unit.source: Google Tag Manager streamlines web tracking and code management, ensuring data compliance and control for developers.
trans-unit.target: Ka whakangāwari a Google Tag Manager i te aroturuki tukutuku me te whakahaere waehere, me te whakarite kia ū ki ngā ture raraunga me te mana whakahaere mā ngā kaiwhakawhanake.

trans-unit.source: SalesViewer analyzes website visits for B2B lead generation and may identify company-related visitor information based on usage and technical access data.

trans-unit.source: X (formerly Twitter) is a social media platform that allows users to share and interact with short messages and multimedia content. Developers can integrate Twitter features into websites to enhance user engagement and real-time updates while maintaining data privacy compliance and adhering to coding guidelines.
trans-unit.target: Ko X (i mua ko Twitter) he papaaho pāpāho pāpori e āhei ai ngā kaiwhakamahi ki te tuku me te taunekeneke ki ngā karere poto me ngā ihirangi rongorau. Ka taea e ngā kaiwhakawhanake te whakauru āhuatanga Twitter ki roto i ngā paetukutuku hei whakarei i te whai wāhi mai o ngā kaiwhakamahi me ngā whakahōutanga ā-tūturu, me te pupuri tonu i te ū ki te tūmataiti raraunga me ngā coding guidelines.
